module: Test simulation for the stage start countdown (staged countdown). Reproduces a wall clock from the environment's time of day and schedules the start event at the next full minute (or the following one if less than 15 s remain). Used in test mode by the countdown node; the epoch is advanced by the caller.
notes: The start time in seconds = ((tod.time * 24 + 12) % 24) * 3600 (tod.time = 0 corresponds to noon); if core_environment is absent, midnight (0).
In calculateScheduledEventTime the variable minutesToAdd is computed but never used (the 60 s offset is applied separately).

C.desc: Test instance. Fields: epoch (seconds elapsed since the start), environmentStartTimeSecs (starting wall-clock time in seconds), scheduledEventTime (epoch of the scheduled event).

init.desc: Reads the environment time, initializes epoch = 0 and schedules the event.

calculateScheduledEventTime.desc: Schedules scheduledEventTime at the next full minute of the wall clock; if less than 15 s remain before it, uses the following minute. The result is expressed as an epoch (relative to the start).

reschedule.desc: Reschedules the event: full minute following the old time plus slotSizeMinutes minutes. Marks as already triggered the warnings whose remaining delay has already passed.

slotSizeMinutes.desc: Size of the added slot, in minutes.

rescheduleCount.desc: Number of reschedulings already done (only used for the log).

defaultWarningTimes.desc: Warning delays in seconds before the event.

warningsTriggered.desc: Table modified in place: warningsTriggered[delay] = true if the delay has passed.

returns.desc: New epoch of the scheduled event.
